# Scipedia

> > Scipedia is an open-access scientific publishing platform enabling researchers to create, share, and collaborate on peer-reviewed documents with support for LaTeX, Word, and Google Docs.

Scipedia is a comprehensive digital publishing ecosystem that supports the full lifecycle of scientific research—from manuscript submission and peer-review to journal management and open-access dissemination. The platform serves academic institutions, research groups, and scientific organizations worldwide.

## Key Topics

- Open-access publishing
- Peer-review process
- Scientific publishing
- Journal management
- Research collaboration
- LaTeX support
- Google Docs integration
- Academic platform
- Document categories
- Research classification
- Data repository
- Editorial workflow
- ISSN registration
- Committee on Publication Ethics
- Creative Commons licensing

## Getting Started

- [Scipedia Homepage](https://www.scipedia.com): Main entry point to Scipedia's open-access scientific publishing platform supporting LaTeX, Word, and Google Docs
- [About Us](https://www.scipedia.com/legal/aboutus): Company overview of Scipedia S.L. and related SaaS solutions including BIM TeamUp
- [Help Center](https://www.scipedia.com/help): Help center with FAQs covering publishing, peer-review, and account management

## Publishing & Journals

- [Create a New Journal](https://www.scipedia.com/help/journals): Guide for creating new journals with ISSN and editorial board setup on Scipedia
- [Peer-Review & Manuscript Submission](https://www.scipedia.com/help/review): Tutorial on peer-review process and manuscript submission for Scipedia journals
- [All Groups & Organizations](https://www.scipedia.com/groups/all): Directory of research groups, scientific organizations, and academic journals on Scipedia

## Content Discovery

- [Featured Documents by Category](https://www.scipedia.com/sciepedia_categories/all): Browse featured documents by research category and academic discipline taxonomy
- [Sitemaps & Document Index](https://www.scipedia.com/sitemaps/all): Sitemap and document index for browsing publications and conference proceedings by year

## Legal & Compliance

- [Terms of Use](https://www.scipedia.com/legal/termsofuse): Legal terms of use covering content licensing, Creative Commons, and platform policies
- [Publishing Ethics](https://www.scipedia.com/legal/ethics): Publishing ethics guidelines aligned with Committee on Publication Ethics standards
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.scipedia.com/legal/privacypolicy): Data protection and GDPR compliance policy for Scipedia user accounts and data
